# Request: Merging Two Accounts

## [Request: Merging Two Accounts](https://discourse.ubuntu.com/t/request-merging-two-accounts/84279)

I would like merge this account and [@belkinsa](https://discourse.ubuntu.com/u/belkinsa) into one under the e-mail that I registered under on this one. For [@belkinsa](https://discourse.ubuntu.com/u/belkinsa), I would like be removed from the Ubuntu Members group as I was inactive for too long.

> I would like be removed from the Ubuntu Members group as I was inactive for too long.

Your non-Ubuntu *email* link matched (on LP) but I didn’t do the first bit sorry, I wasn’t 100% sure of ‘merge from’ in [docs](https://meta.discourse.org/t/merging-user-accounts/275288) so I stopped (*chickened-out*).

[@aaronprisk](https://discourse.ubuntu.com/u/aaronprisk) [@rubi1200](https://discourse.ubuntu.com/u/rubi1200) has suggested it maybe better if you do it, to ensure we “*preserve the old topics etc*”.

Oh, I guess any other teams/groups that I’m of too. I’m not sure if I would return to those at the moment. Thank you again.

I removed you ([@belkinsa](https://discourse.ubuntu.com/u/belkinsa) account) from [Ubuntu unity developers - Ubuntu Community Hub](https://discourse.ubuntu.com/g/ubuntu-unity-devs)
